scenarios.name: at_then_list_roundtrip_ms
scenarios.note: Canonical absolute time is epoch MILLISECONDS. Node's scheduleAt already takes ms; Python's schedule_at takes seconds (P1-6), so the same ms value read as seconds lands ~60000 AD, past the ~100-year horizon, and at() rejects it — registered python gap.

scenarios.name: cancel_at_recalls_a_pending_oneshot
scenarios.note: One-shots created by at() can be recalled by JobId (send-later / disappearing-message cancellation) — P1-3.

scenarios.name: namespace_isolation
scenarios.note: Schedules are scoped per app (P1-2): a cron registered in one namespace must not appear in another's list(), and names don't collide across apps.
